algorithm_adapter_not_implemented.meaning: In-scope algorithmic package without an implemented, validated operation adapter.

data_structure_adapter_not_implemented.meaning: Official chapter <title> defines a data structure; the MCP uses typed artifacts for exchange and has no dedicated operation or adapter for it yet (not excluded: operations over it remain in scope).

generic_support_infrastructure.meaning: Official chapter <title> is generic-programming or arithmetic infrastructure (concepts, number types, containers, property maps, graph/solver adapters) consumed by other packages; it has no standalone geometric operation to expose.

gui_only.meaning: Official chapter <title> is an interactive visualization/GUI integration (Qt Graphics View, Ipe, or the Basic Viewer); it produces no headless geometric result that a typed artifact operation could return.

has_validated_operations.meaning: At least one VALIDATED operation lists this package as its primary package (derived, never listed here).

io_only.meaning: Official chapter <title> covers stream/file I/O and formatting; file formats are handled by the MCP artifact import/export layer, not as geometry operations.

needs_third_party_lib.meaning: Whole package unusable without a third-party library that is not available in the build; no package currently qualifies (optional-dependency packages such as Polygonal_surface_reconstruction/SCIP are built and validated).

no_public_headers.meaning: Chapter <title> (profiling tools, hash map, union-find, modifiers) has 0 headers attributed to it in the pinned 6.2.1 release tree and no license tag in the Package Overview; nothing is available to wrap.

unclassified_in_policy.meaning: Fallback emitted when no policy entry exists; the gate fails while any package carries it.
